# `adt auth`

Authentication commands

```bash
adt auth [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                | Description                                                               |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt auth login`       | Login to ADT - supports Basic Auth and Browser-based SSO                  |
| `adt auth logout`      | Logout from ADT                                                           |
| `adt auth status`      | Check authentication status                                               |
| `adt auth list`        | List all authenticated SAP systems                                        |
| `adt auth set-default` | Set the default SAP system                                                |
| `adt auth refresh`     | Refresh authentication session (auto-falls back to interactive if needed) |

## `adt auth login`

Login to ADT - supports Basic Auth and Browser-based SSO

```bash
adt auth login [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                 | Description                                                          | Default |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--service-key <path>` | Path to a BTP service key JSON file for service-key login            |         |
| `--redirect-uri <uri>` | OAuth callback redirect URI (e.g. Codespaces/tunnel URL)             |         |
| `--insecure`           | Allow insecure SSL connections (ignore certificate errors)           |         |
| `--skip-verify`        | Skip credential verification against the SAP system (offline logins) |         |

## `adt auth logout`

Logout from ADT

```bash
adt auth logout [options]
```

**Options**

| Option        | Description                                            | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--sid <sid>` | System ID to logout from (defaults to current default) |         |

## `adt auth status`

Check authentication status

```bash
adt auth status [options]
```

**Options**

| Option        | Description                                      | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--sid <sid>` | System ID to check (defaults to current default) |         |

## `adt auth list`

List all authenticated SAP systems

Aliases: `ls`

```bash
adt auth list [options]
```

## `adt auth set-default`

Set the default SAP system

```bash
adt auth set-default [options] <sid>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                             | Default |
| -------- | --------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<sid>`  | System ID to set as default (e.g., TRL) |         |

## `adt auth refresh`

Refresh authentication session (auto-falls back to interactive if needed)

```bash
adt auth refresh [options]
```

**Options**

| Option        | Description                                        | Default |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--sid <sid>` | System ID to refresh (defaults to current default) |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
